creditLine: Photos by Seyl Park, Afton Lorenz, Hannah Erickson, and Jeff Bannister for SparkPoint
usage: Share them about the convening — on social media, in newsletters, reports, presentations, and news coverage.
Credit the photos to SparkPoint and the photographers when you post.
Please don't alter them in ways that change the moment, or use them in advertising.

sets.title: In the room
sets.note: A full house in the barn at Deerwoode Reserve.

sets.title: Walking the system
sets.note: Small groups working through the Rural Health Field Simulator.

sets.title: Out on the grounds
sets.note: Circles under the pavilion, around the fire ring, and out on the lawn.

photos.title: A full house
photos.alt: A wide view of the event barn at Deerwoode Reserve, every round table filled with attendees beneath rows of chandeliers, a presentation slide on the far screen.

photos.title: From the back of the room
photos.alt: From the back of the barn, attendees at round tables face a speaker at the podium, with tall glass garage doors and chandeliers overhead.

photos.title: Across the table
photos.alt: Two attendees in conversation at a round table—one in a red jacket listening, hand at her chin, the other in a green blouse speaking and gesturing.

photos.title: At the station
photos.alt: Attendees wearing name badges hold simulator handouts and a tablet at a station beside a First Citizens Bank banner.

photos.title: Story cards in hand
photos.alt: Four attendees read printed story cards together at a simulator station.

photos.title: Station C6
photos.alt: Attendees with tablets gather around a blue-draped simulator station table marked C6 under the open-air pavilion.

photos.title: Every choice on the tablet
photos.alt: Three attendees lean in over a tablet and a folder in the afternoon sun outside the barn.

photos.title: Working it through
photos.alt: Four attendees crowd around a tablet outdoors, talking through a simulator scenario together.

photos.title: Under the pavilion
photos.alt: Attendees sit in a wide circle of chairs and benches under the pavilion, mid-discussion, with the grounds behind them.

photos.title: Around the fire ring
photos.alt: A circle of attendees in blue Adirondack chairs around a stone fire ring, beside a log cabin and a wooden gazebo.

photos.title: Out on the lawn
photos.alt: A small group talks in a circle of Adirondack chairs on the grass at the edge of the woods.
